newsitem.title: UK: Sugar freight market quiet, no orders reported.
newsitem.headline: Sugar freight market quiet, no orders reported.

text.p: London's sugar freight market started the week on a quiet note with no new business or fixtures reported, shipbrokers said on Monday.
"It's very quiet, I haven't seen anything quoted this morning," said one shipbroker.
Elsewhere, Brazil sugar shipments out of key centre-south ports reached 623,402 tonnes in July, over 11 percent down on the 705,326 tonnes shipped last July.
Santos was the top sugar exporting port with total shipments of 371,577 tonnes but was below the 497,894 tonnes exported from the port in July 1996.
Syria has tendered to buy 26,000 tonnes of white sugar and 26,000 of raws for October delivery.
The sugar is to delivered in two equal shipments of 13,000 tonnes of whites and two of 13,000 tonnes of raws. September 9 is the final date to receive price offers
